agent-readiness.panelStarting.heading: Setting up your citation panel
agent-readiness.panelStarting.benchmarkB: Your scan is complete. We’re now running the industry benchmark to rank you against competitors — this usually takes a few minutes. Your results appear here automatically.

agent-readiness.panelStarting.note: This usually takes a few minutes, feel free to leave this page and come back. Your results will appear here automatically when ready.
agent-readiness.hero.visibilityTip: The share of answers in this category that cite your site as a source when people ask.
agent-readiness.hero.prominenceTip: When you are cited, how prominently you appear — how much of the cited content is yours and how early it lands. A quality score, not a share of your citations.
agent-readiness.hero.mentionsTip: How often answer engines name your brand in this category — whether or not they cite you.
AI assistants rarely cite your domain when answering questions in this category.
AI assistants cite your domain some of the time, but you're not a go-to source yet for answers.
AI assistants cite your domain in many of their answers, making you a common source.
AI assistants consistently cite your domain, treating you as a go-to source for answers.
When your domain is cited, only a small part of the answer comes from you.
When your domain is cited, you contribute a moderate share of the answer provided.
When your domain is cited, you contribute a large share of the answer provided.
When your domain is cited, you drive most of the answer provided.
agent-readiness.hero.summary.mentions.lo: AI answers rarely name your brand in this category.
agent-readiness.hero.summary.mentions.mo: AI answers name your brand some of the time, alongside your competitors.
agent-readiness.hero.summary.mentions.go: AI answers name your brand often, keeping pace with your competitors.
agent-readiness.hero.summary.mentions.ex: AI answers name your brand regularly, more than most competitors.
agent-readiness.citation.heading: Your citations
agent-readiness.citation.description: How answer engines cite your site when they answer questions in this category — measured first-party, on your own domain.
agent-readiness.citation.gap: Answer engines mention you in %{mentions} of answers but only cite you in %{visibility} — a chance to earn the citation, not just the mention.
agent-readiness.citation.pending: We are probing answer engines with real questions from your category. Your citation metrics appear here as soon as the panel completes — usually within a few minutes.
agent-readiness.citation.running: We're probing answer engines with your questions right now. This usually takes a few minutes — feel free to leave this page and come back. Your citation metrics appear here automatically once the panel finishes.
agent-readiness.promptTabs.empty: No responses to show here yet.
agent-readiness.promptTabs.error: We couldn't load these responses. Please try again in a moment.
agent-readiness.questions.heading: Questions & citations
agent-readiness.questions.description: The real questions we asked answer engines in this category, and which assistants cited you. Expand a question to read each assistant’s answer and the sources it cited.
agent-readiness.assistants.heading: Breakdown by AI assistant
agent-readiness.assistants.description: For each assistant: how many answers we sampled, how often it cited you, how prominently you appeared when cited, and how often it mentioned you.
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.sub: Total crawls, referrals, and coverage across AI operators, with a per-operator breakdown of activity and errors.
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.car: The total number of times AI assistants read your domain’s content
The total number of users who visited your site from an AI assistant
Proportion of operators where you are both crawled and referred
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.gap: We’re still collecting AI operator activity for this zone. Check back once the first daily update completes.
No AI crawler or referral activity for this zone in the selected window. Operators appear here once they start fetching or citing your content.
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.int: Crawls show which AI operators read your content and referrals which send you visitors — operators that crawl but never refer are ingesting your content without citing you back (the reciprocity gap to close). Errors count the 403 (blocked) + 404 (dead link) responses you returned them.
agent-readiness.som.heading: Share of Voice
agent-readiness.som.description: Your share of AI citations versus the competitive set, across the models we probe.
agent-readiness.som.unrankedSummary: You are not yet among the top cited domains. Competitors capture the AI answers for now.
agent-readiness.som.tier.low.summary: You win a small slice of AI citations, ranking #%{rank}. Competitors capture most of the answers.
agent-readiness.som.tier.moderate.summar: You hold a moderate share of AI citations, ranking #%{rank}. There is real room to climb.
agent-readiness.som.tier.good.summary: You hold a strong share of AI citations, ranking #%{rank}. You are ahead of most competitors.
agent-readiness.som.tier.excellent.summa: You lead AI citations, ranking #%{rank}. Answer engines cite you more than anyone else.
agent-readiness.industryFit.misaligned: Your content looks more like %{suggested} than %{current}. If that’s a better fit, consider changing your market.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.title: Citation quality
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.subtitl: How useful your citations are when AI assistants cite you, judged across seven quality dimensions and scored out of 100%.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.caveatB: The seven dimensions a judge scores when your site is cited, averaged across answers (1–5). This data should be considered directional, not definitive, as an experimental signal rated by an AI model.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.tier.lo: When AI assistants cite you, the citations add little to their answers. There is a lot of room to become a more useful, quotable source.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.tier.mo: Your citations contribute to AI answers, but inconsistently. Sharpening relevance and authority would make you a stronger source.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.tier.go: Your citations meaningfully shape AI answers. You are a solid, useful source across most quality dimensions.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.tier.ex: Your citations are high quality: relevant, influential, and authoritative. You are well positioned to become a go-to source for AI assistants.
agent-readiness.qualityBreakdown.dimensi: How on-topic your citation is to the question asked
How much your citation shapes the assistant’s answer
Whether you offer information other cited sources don’t
Whether you add a distinct perspective to the answer
How authoritative your site appears as a source
How likely the answer leaves a reader with a follow-up your content can serve
How likely a reader is to click through to your site
